text:
maya: Quick thread for Friday's webinar ops: captions vendor, demo fallback owner, dry-run time. Can panelists join 45m early? @aj @sam @lexi
aj: Yep T-45 works. For captions do we want vendor-generated SRT or live auto captions?
lexi: Vendor SRT preferred for post-event clips. Live auto-capions (WebVTT) as live fallback. I'll own vendor order if OK.
maya: Please own it. Target turnaround: transcript + SRT within 24h. Also need speaker clip permissions. I'll add a consent checkbox to speaker prep.
sam: Demo infra notes: staging demo URL https://staging.redwood.ai/demo-stream. Token env WEBINAR_TOKEN. Default TTL 90m; I'll create token exp = webinar_end + 45m buffer.
aj: Grant ops for fallback toggle to maya and sam (webcast-admin). I'll run the rctl command now.
aj: `rctl grants create --role webcast-admin --user sam` and same for maya.
sam: I'll also add a simple monitor that posts to #marketing if avg token latency > 6s for 2m; fallback rule: swap to recording if sustained >6s or error rate >5%.
sam: snippet: ```bash
# poll latency, post slack alert
curl -s https://metrics.staging.redwood.ai/demo/latency | jq .avg > /tmp/lat
```
kim: Accessibility checklist: slide alt text, readable font sizes, color contrast, captions during broadcast, transcript posted. Also request live caption WebVTT from caption service. Opsbot, is caption service enabled on staging?
opsbot: caption-service: enabled; ws://captions.staging.redwood.ai/vtt; token required; status=healthy
maya: Run-of-show recap: T-45 panel join, T-20 mic check & slides, T-5 host intro, 0 go live, demo at 18m, Q&A 35-50m, close 55-60m. Host cue sheet will reference slide numbers.
lexi: I can be backup demo presenter. Will rehearse with staging token today at 16:00.
aj: Upload recorded fallback clip to staging bucket: gs://rw-webinar/fallbacks/demo-cut.mp4. Sam, can you verify playback before show?
sam: Verified. Also wiring analytics events: demo_started, demo_fallback, recording_played. Pushing to webinar dashboard.
maya: Final action items: Lexi owns captions vendor and backup presenter; Sam owns tokens, monitor, recording check; AJ owns admin grants; Kim owns accessibility checklist; Opsbot creates calendar invite for dry-run T-45 (15m) tomorrow at 09:15.
opsbot: calendar-invite: created (participants: maya, aj, sam, kim, lexi), reminder=15m
maya: Thanks all. I'll post the final run-of-show link in this thread when updated.
